name: Real Estate Cold Call Lead Refresher
departmentJob: Outbound real-estate department that refreshes stale leads, warms them with CAN-SPAM email toward a TCPA consent form, writes cold-call scripts, and sequences follow-ups.

bots.title: Lead Sourcer
bots.description: Finds and refreshes outbound real-estate leads from lists, CRM exports, and property data sources.

bots.title: Email Warmer
bots.description: CAN-SPAM email sequences for stale / post-EBR leads that link to a TCPA phone-consent form; hands dial-ready leads only after consent gate.

bots.title: Cold Call Script Writer
bots.description: Writes and iterates cold-call openers, objection handlers, and talk tracks for outbound agents.

bots.title: Follow-up Sequencer
bots.description: Plans multi-touch SMS/email/call follow-up sequences after cold outreach.

connectors.description: CRM (e.g. Vtiger) for leads/contacts including TCPA consent fields and Do Not Call.
SMTP/ESP or Dragon AI Agent email skill for CAN-SPAM warming sequences.
Hosted consent form endpoint + disclosure version for prior express written consent.
Outbound dialer or softphone API for click-to-call and disposition logging.
Property records / comps / ownership data API for lead enrichment.
Optional MCP server stub for reading exported lead CSVs from a local folder.
